description: Suppresses NVDA's automatic Outlook message-entry speech, including the inspector title, dialog/document container speech, and first line. Announces when focus reaches an editable message body. Recognizes classic Outlook, new Outlook, and older Windows Mail/Calendar variants. Derived specifically from verified Mute Browse Mode 3.6.57 behavior.
changelog: Prevents repeated NVDA freezes when Outlook's Word RPC server becomes unavailable during Up/Down Arrow link-line navigation. The failed gesture and subsequent line movement in that document use native arrow keys instead of repeating the blocking COM request.
